pattern_explanation: These words look almost identical in both languages because both borrowed them from French or Latin, so English speakers may assume they mean the same thing. Over time their meanings shifted in Turkish, and the English counterparts now carry different senses.
false_friend_warning: Each of these words looks like an English word but has a different meaning, so translating it literally leads to errors. Students should learn the English meaning separately rather than relying on the resemblance.
